name: Board
description: Organize work as cards across todo, doing, and done.
useWhen: Use for task planning, progress tracking, assignments, or work that should persist on the Board.
skills: The board has todo, doing, and done columns. Use create to add work, update to change card fields, and move to change columns. Assignee is null or a mate ID. A mate cannot create or move a card directly into done; use propose_done when the work is complete, then the user confirms it.
